newsitem.title: ITALY: Manuli Rubber H1 sales up, positive on '97.
newsitem.headline: Manuli Rubber H1 sales up, positive on '97.

text.p: Newly-quoted Manuli Rubber Industries on Tuesday reported a rise in sales of nine percent to 230 billion lire in the first half of 1997, and said prospects were encouraging for the whole year.

A statement from Manuli said operating profitability was being maintained at around the 16 percent level seen at the end of the first quarter, and the company added "prospects are encouraging for the whole of 1997".
Manuli started trading on the Milan bourse on July 18, and the shares were last quoted at 1000 GMT up 1.48 percent at 5,700 lire compared to a flotation price of 5,650 lire.

The group which makes rubber tubes, couplings and assemblies for fluid transmission in auto and hydraulic applications reported 1996 net profits of 37.6 billion lire against 36.8 billion lire on net turnover of 382.2 billion lire against 395.2 billion lire in 1995.
